en: Multi-view vintage postcard with the printed caption 'Gruss aus Kronstadt.' showing four small images: the Rathaus (town hall) with a busy market, the Marktplatz, 'Villa Kertsch', and 'Schlossberg'. Publisher credit 'W. Hiemesch, Kronstadt.' appears on the left. The reverse has Hungarian 'LEVELEZŐ-LAP' and a Budapest postmark dated 98.VII.18, addressed in German to a recipient in Hermannstadt.
